description: 双车对王-L1 演示：双车割草，轮番压排将死

intro.popup_en: The two-rook mowing method: one rook controls a rank or file, then the other crosses over to take the next one. Tighten the box and checkmate in three moves.
intro.popup: 💡 <b>双车割草：双车轮番封排或列，收紧包围——三步将死！

outro.popup_en: Rh2 is checkmate. The two rooks work like a mowing team: one rook controls a rank, the other crosses it to control the next, steadily squeezing the black king until it has no escape.
outro.popup: ✅ Rh2 — 将死！要点：双车「割草机」——一车先占一排，另一车越过再占一排，逐步把黑王压入无路可走！

moves.popup_en: 1. Rg1: the rook moves to g1, ready to seal the g- and h-files and confine the black king to the h-file.
moves.popup:
⬆️ 1.Rg1 — 车移到g1，准备封锁g/h列！
车从移到g1，把黑王封锁在h列

moves.popup_en: The black king can now move only up and down the h-file.
moves.popup: ⬇️ Kh6 — 黑王只能在h列上下移动了！

moves.popup_en: 2. Ra2: the other rook moves to a2, preparing to control the second rank. Note that Black cannot simply play ...Rh5 here.
moves.popup: ⬆️ <b>2.Ra2 — 另一车走到a2为下一步到和列做准备！注意黑车此时不可以直接到h5!

moves.popup_en: The black king is forced back to the h-file.
moves.popup: ⬆️ Kh7 — 黑王只能退回在h列活动！

moves.popup_en: 3. Rh2 is checkmate. The rook crosses the rank and completes the two-rook squeeze.
moves.popup:
⬆️ 3.Rh2# — 将死！
车沿平移到h2，双车割草完成！
